# `apps`

Group: **Applications**. The V2X applications vehicles run on what they hear, and how drivers follow their advice.

7 settings. The status column says whether editing a setting changes a run; see [how to read these tables](../overview.md). Paths use `[]` for a list element and `*` for a map key.

## Choices

The labelled values of every closed or model setting above.

??? note "`apps.enabled[]`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `fcw` | Forward collision warning | Warns when the car ahead is closing at a time to collision of 2.4 s or less. |
 | `eebl` | Emergency electronic brake light | Warns when a vehicle ahead brakes harder than 0.4 g. |
 | `ima` | Intersection movement assist | Warns of a crossing vehicle about to reach the same conflict point. |
 | `lta` | Left turn assist | Warns a left turner when the oncoming gap is too short. |
 | `bsw` | Blind spot warning | Warns of a vehicle in the blind spot before a lane change. |
 | `pcw` | Pedestrian collision warning | Warns when a pedestrian or cyclist will be in the path within 3 s. |
 | `rlvw` | Red light violation warning | Warns when the driver can no longer stop comfortably for a red. |
 | `glosa` | Green light speed advisory | Advises the speed that arrives on green; drivers follow it at the compliance share. |
